# Grand Hyatt Kids Club

> The kids club at Grand Hyatt Dubai is a supervised play and activity space for younger guests of the hotel. It sits within the resort's leisure wing, alongside the pools, restaurants and gardens that occupy the grounds between Dubai Creek and Dubai Healthcare City. Grand Hyatt Dubai opened in March 2003 and holds 710 rooms and suites, so the club serves a large resident family clientele.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Oud Metha, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Grand Hyatt Dubai is a large resort-style hotel in Oud Metha, set in landscaped gardens overlooking Dubai Creek. This project delivered the hotel's dedicated kids club, with Sumer Contracting as main contractor and Arkiteknik International as consultant. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the kids club, providing the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services for this family-focused facility.
